method.description: Source-and-behavior-evidence review of all 140 named requirements; equal feature weights. This is an audited implementation-coverage estimate, not percentage of engineering hours or production-release acceptance.
method.working: Named feature implemented and wired, with behavior evidence; not a blanket clean-machine/hardware certification.
method.unverified: Implementation appears present, but essential runtime, hardware, account or acceptance evidence is missing.
method.partial: Real working subset exists; a material part of the named requirement is absent.
method.preview: Planning, manual simulation or preview only; the requested operational capability does not run.
method.missing: No functioning implementation of the named requirement.

scopeNotes: All 140 original requirements retained. Baseline all-feature audit through29, with source/behavior review of accepted changes through34 and recovered40 slices.
Feature implementation coverage is a rubric estimate, not production-release acceptance or percentage of hours.
No paid provider requests performed for local recovery; live BYOK/OAuth/hardware acceptance remains explicit.
remainingCriticalWork: Real OAuth account connections and provider registrations
Local vision, embeddings and verified model/runtime installation
Clean-machine installer lifecycle, signing/update rollback and hardware acceptance
